entry.title: DroneXXL 0.1.0
entry.summary: DroneXXL 0.1.0 - drone and experimental synth for the Akai Force / MPC (VST2), after the Solar 42, built on Neil Baumberger's AmbientModules (GPL-3.0-or-later). 15-module rack, tap-to-patch cables, 8 macros, XY pad, randomizer, brickwall limiter (ceiling default -3 dBFS, never above -1 dB). Presets: Pulsar, Solar 42, Cinematic Performance, Meditations on Death. Testing status: tested on an Akai Force, MPC OS 3.1.9, by the author. No CPU benchmark yet. Needs MPC OS 3.x (not 2.x).
